name: Maxim Shubarev
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2024-2025); Hurun Global (2025-2026)
forbes_bio: Maxim Shubarev is the founder of Setl Group, one of Russia's largest real estate developers.
Shubarev first worked as a radio equipment assembler before starting Petersburg Real Estate in the 1990s.
In 2006 the company rebranded and changed its name to Setl Group.
The company has built about 350 apartment buildings in three decades.

name: Arash Ferdowsi
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2023); Hurun Global (2021-2025); Hurun Global U40 (2021-2023)
forbes_bio: Arash Ferdowsi is a cofounder of Dropbox, a file sharing and storage service that has more than 500 million users.
Ferdowsi launched Dropbox in 2007 while he was still a student at MIT, with MIT graduate Drew Houston, who is the CEO.
The company went public in March 2018; shares jumped on the first day of trading.
Ferdowsi, who formerly served as the company's chief technology officer, owns a nearly 10% stake in the company.
forbes_facts: He and cofounder Drew Houston turned down an acquisition offer from Apple's Steve Jobs in 2009.
Ferdowsi is the son of Iranian refugees.

name: Sandra MacMillan
forbes_bio: Sandra MacMillan is one of 21 billionaire heirs to Cargill, America's largest private company.
Her great-grandfather, W.W. Cargill, founded the business as a single grain warehouse on the end of an Iowa railroad line in 1865.
Sh's one of nine billionaire siblings who inherited stakes in the company from their father John H.  MacMillan III, who died in 2008.
The family still owns roughly 90% of Cargill, which did $154 billion in 2025 sales across food, agriculture, financial and industrial divisions.

name: Nie Yunchen
appears_on: Hurun Global (2022-2026); Hurun China (2020-2026); Hurun Global U40 (2022-2026); Hurun China U40 (2020-2022); Hurun Unicorn founders (2020-2026)

name: Lv Yongxiang
forbes_bio: Lv is the founder of the Jilin Yongda Group, a supplier of magnetic switches.
Lv worked for state-owned Petrochina before he founded the predecessor to Yongda in 1986.

name: Marc Samwer
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2026); Forbes annual (2015-2025); Hurun Global (2018-2026)
forbes_bio: Marc Samwer and his brothers Alexander and Oliver founded Berlin-based tech incubator Rocket Internet in 2007 and took it public in October 2014.
Together, they own around 44% of Rocket. The company was valued at more than $8 billion at the time of its IPO.
Inspired by the dot-com boom, the Samwers created a German auction site, Alando, in 1999 and sold it to eBay for $43 million after a few months.
That was followed by the creation of mobile phone content provider Jamba!, which was sold to Verisign in 2004 for $273 million.
forbes_facts: Marc studied law at the University of Cologne.

name: Masatoshi Kumagai
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2021); Forbes annual (2021); Hurun Global (2018-2024)
forbes_bio: Masatoshi Kumagai founded the predecessor to GMO Internet in 1991.
GMO, which is publicly traded, provides internet services to online brokerages, foreign exchange trading services and others.
GMO Internet is also creating smartphone games and has an identity protection business.

name: Bhavish Aggarwal
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2025); Hurun Global (2022-2026); Hurun India (2015-2019); Hurun Global U40 (2022-2026); Hurun Unicorn founders (2019-2025)
forbes_bio: Bhavish Aggarwal is cofounder and CEO of Bangalore-based ride-hailing platform Ola Cabs, which he started in 2010.
The computer engineer also cofounded Ola Electric, a maker of electric scooters and motorcycles and EV components, in 2017. He took it public in August 2024.
Aggarwal's third venture is AI startup Krutrim, which became a unicorn a year after he set it up in 2023.
Krutrim offers basic AI assistant services  such as drafting emails, information retrieval and travel planning, in multiple Indian languages.
forbes_facts: He does not own a car because he staunchly believes in ride-hailing services.
"Krutrim" means artificial in the Indian language of Sanskrit.
In February 2025,  he said he would be personally investing $230 million in his AI outfit Krutrim.

name: Yogesh Kothari
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2025); Forbes annual (2022-2024); Hurun Global (2021-2024)
forbes_bio: Yogesh Kothari is chairman and managing director of Alkyl Amines Chemicals, a Mumbai specialty chemicals manufacturer.
The Mumbai company was set up by him in 1979 and listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange in 1981.
Alkyl Amines supplies to the pharmaceutical, agrochemical and rubber chemical industries.
His older brother Hemendra Kothari is a veteran investment banker and also a billionaire.
